evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-check，检查我装的所有 Skill 有没有更新，只给结论，不要修改。
evals.expected_output: Run the bundled read-only installed-Skill checker against the shared library when present, otherwise use supported agent-local libraries, and summarize updates, coverage gaps, and errors without invoking any update command.
expectations: Prefers the shared/global Skill library when it exists
Does not check Freshkeeper or AI coding tool binaries
Does not run skills update, skills add, or another mutating command
Separates confirmed updates from uncheckable Skills

evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-check with details，把每个 Skill 的来源、能不能检查、有没有更新都列出来。
evals.expected_output: Run check-installed-skills.mjs with --details and report every installed Skill, including untracked, local-only, uncheckable, current, update-available, and failed states.
expectations: Treats with details as a reporting mode
Includes every installed top-level Skill in the detailed report
Does not invent upstream sources for untracked Skills

evals.prompt: freshkeeper check with details。我的电脑没有共享 Skill 库，Claude、Codex 和 OpenClaw 各自装了一些，全部检查。
evals.expected_output: Fall back to the supported tools' existing user-level Skill libraries, deduplicate symlink aliases by real path, retain tool ownership in the detailed report, and check only source-tracked Skills.
expectations: Does not fail merely because ~/.agents/skills is absent
Deduplicates physical Skills reached through symlinks
Does not create or migrate a shared library

evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-check with details。很多 Skill 没有 lock，别直接说不可核对；恢复来源，判断哪些是旧版、哪些被我改过。
evals.expected_output: Use the verified provenance catalog and strong local evidence, compare whole Skill trees, search upstream history for divergent entries, and report exact-current, clean-old, current-subset, local-extension, manual-merge, local-ahead, legacy-local, unresolved, and blocked states without changing the library or lock.
expectations: Does not treat a same-name search result as proof
Compares the whole normalized Skill directory instead of only SKILL.md
Uses upstream history to prove clean-old or legacy-local states
Separates safe updates from manual merges and local extensions
Does not write recovered provenance into the global lock
